name: volvox_lab
frame: FR20 base (URDF): Z up from the base's mounting face; the arm's zero pose points along -X, which is the robot's working front; metres
source: MEASURED 2026-09-25 with scripts/probe_ui.py on the real FR20: floor (level), left partition and TV wall (vertical fits), ceiling by tape (2.16 m). The room is square (walls 90.5 deg apart) and turned ~11 deg from the robot's axes. Still ESTIMATED: tv, furniture_back, plant, chairs (re-placed against the measured TV wall), shelves_right, control_cart (known wrong), operator zones, base_plate. The first estimate was from photos, 2026-09-24.
